first.radio: Your barrel is rolled sheet scrap. The fabricator can press alloy into proper plate: three measures of alloy and two of nanites a plate. Bore a true barrel and your shots will hit like they mean it. Schematics discovered: Refined Alloy Plate, Bored Alloy Barrel.
first.speaker: Warden Ossa

first.radio: Now it hits like it means it. The workers won't shrug that off.
first.speaker: Warden Ossa

continued.radio: Listen. Something big just woke in the depot's processing hall: a foreman unit, still running its old shift. It's slow, but it hits hard and shrugs off a stagger. When its optics flare red, step back. Put it down and bring me its control core.
continued.speaker: Warden Ossa
